scope: fixed purged-validation score grid; GPU search continues independently; no holdout

design.scope: fixed matched risk direction and alpha scale grid; purged validation only; no test
notes: Only forecast-date native alpha mean/dispersion and trailing-price risks enter score shaping.
Native linear and normalized linear have identical within-seed ranks but may have different avg_none ensemble ranks.
Positive shaping removes the low-risk score bonus; high-risk penalties remain.
The original Top30/drop5/risk_degree/costs remain fixed; no volatility targeting or exposure changes.
These are original scoring adaptations, not a replication of volatility-managed portfolios.

sources.relationship: motivation to examine risks separately; original paper changes portfolio exposures, this scoring experiment does not
